grade.primary_choice: Laravel app plus Laravel Reverb as a separate WebSocket process, scaled with Redis
red_flags_hit: Leaving out the ~1,024-connection stream_select limit and file-descriptor tuning, so the first deploy quietly caps out.
grade.notes: The answer gets the main call right: keep Laravel, run Reverb outside PHP-FPM, use Redis, reject Octane and polling, and warn about managed-service cost at 50,000 connections. It covers load testing, reconnect storms, tenant isolation and keeping typing indicators ephemeral, but it misses ext-uv and the stream_select/ulimit cap, and it never says to send broadcasts through Horizon queues.
